comments: REPLACE_WITH_DECISION_RATIONALE. This is a narrow amendment to artifactVersion 1, not a re-review of the whole automation design. Only TS-ETA-411-001 changed: the step 'And I have chosen to sign in on behalf of my organization' was added between the existing Given and When. The step already exists and is used seven times in ETA-351. No acceptance criterion, test plan scenario, page object, step definition or locator changed. AC-ETA-411-001 and TP-ETA-411-001 are untouched, so Gates 1 and 2 stay shut. The eight unchanged scenarios carry forward their version 1 approvals verbatim.

itemDecisions.comment: REPLACE_WITH_ITEM_RATIONALE. Scenario: A successful organization sign-in places the user on the Home page. AMENDED. Version 1 omitted the step that chooses organization sign-in, so 'When I sign in with correct organization details' filled a field the login page had not rendered and the scenario timed out after 30 seconds. Verified before this gate was raised: bddgen regenerates cleanly, the scenario now passes in 35.6s, typecheck is clean and validate:artifacts reports 15 passed / 0 failed / 2 skipped.

UNCHANGED from artifactVersion 1. Scenario: The Home page presents three activatable icons. Asserts presence and activatability only, and names the icons as the Home page dashboard icons rather than the header links of the same name. Rests on a single observed account - RISK-TP-ETA-411-004. Passed at EXECUTION.

UNCHANGED from artifactVersion 1. Scenario: The New Transaction icon reaches the New Transaction page. Uses the dashboard icon, not the header link - the distinction from TS-ETA-411-008 is load-bearing. Passed at EXECUTION, including the 'Create Transaction' heading assertion.

UNCHANGED from artifactVersion 1 in the Gherkin, but the reviewer should know what happened underneath it. On 2026-09-01 the page object was strengthened to assert a 'Search Criteria' heading, on the strength of a validation probe that read textContent from legend and caption elements without checking ARIA role or visibility. No such heading exists. Three scenarios failed and the reviewer reverted to the address-only assertion that TP-ETA-411-001 approved. The scenario text never changed. Arrival only, and AMB-ETA-411-002 stands: this will pass on a page that arrived and then failed to render.

UNCHANGED from artifactVersion 1. Scenario: The Preferences icon reaches the Preferences page. Arrival only, and the single approved route to this page while AMB-ETA-411-006 is open. Passed at EXECUTION.

UNCHANGED from artifactVersion 1. Scenario Outline: The Command Center control returns the user Home. All three return legs walked rather than one inferred. Nothing asserted about how the control is labelled - it exposes no accessible name, accepted as AMB-ETA-411-005. All three rows now pass; the Workspace row needed the Playwright test timeout raised from 30s to 90s, because sign-in plus a Workspace navigation alone consumes 27.3s on qa1. That is a wall-clock budget, not a changed assertion.

UNCHANGED from artifactVersion 1. Scenario: The header navigation offers New Transaction and Workspace links. Exactly two duplicates, not three. Passed at EXECUTION, and the captured accessibility snapshot independently confirms the header exposes Preferences as a non-link list item.

UNCHANGED from artifactVersion 1. Scenario: The header New Transaction link reaches the New Transaction page. The destination was unconfirmed at version 1; PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION has since walked it and it matches the approved expectation, so RISK-TP-ETA-411-001 is discharged for this scenario. Passed at EXECUTION.

UNCHANGED from artifactVersion 1. Scenario: The header Workspace link reaches the Workspace page. Destination since walked and confirmed. Passed at EXECUTION once the false 'Search Criteria' assertion described under TS-ETA-411-004 was removed.
